name: AttachControlPolicy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the object to which you want to attach the access control policy. Access control policies can be attached to the following objects:

*   Root folder
*   Subfolders of the Root folder
*   Members
parameters.help_zh:
目标节点。取值：

- Root ID：为Root资源夹绑定管控策略。
- 资源夹ID：为资源夹绑定管控策略。
- 成员ID：为成员绑定管控策略
parameters.name: target_id
